name: player_create_from_names_at_pose
description: Player::CreateFromNamesAtPose creates and links a player save-state from object/template names, applies the requested pose and AI net id, registers damage callbacks, binds modal state data, and initializes spawn state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The function has EH setup, inlined strcmp shape, callback call-shape sensitivity, and class/source-cluster interactions that should be handled in a coherent Player bootstrap/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x421ab0 validates the fastcall ECX spawn-position pointer, EDX AI net id, stack yaw/template/object-name arguments, bft_00 network clone special case, normal object lookup and clone fallback, save-state allocation/list insertion, pose setup, root attachment, state initialization, damage callback selection, modal binding loop, destroyed-respawn fallback lookup, spawn initialization, and mission-stat increment for non-local save states.

The native smoke verifies the normal network-name creation path, including save-list insertion, position and yaw conversion, AI net id storage, runtime-scene parent attachment, master common/modal binding, spawn probe initialization, local-player assignment, next ordinal update, and mission-stat preservation for the local player.
